items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: "That Carlos Menotti thing, you know, he did over there one year..."

ctx.x: Well, at least 20 years. Yeah. I know we did a thing over in Spoleto, Italy, you know, and he had a pretty bad heart attack over there. He had to take off. We did an Ed Sullivan thing over there. And he had to take off. That Carlos Menotti thing, you know, he did over there one year, and he had to -- he had to take off for about two, three weeks, and what -- he came back soon as it was, about three weeks after a heart attack like that.

They -- Ed Sullivan was crying. He didn't think he would make it. But Louis was strong. Louis was perhaps the strongest guy I ever worked around, because he -- he didn't -- you know, he didn't try to live carefully or anything like this. He lived the way he wanted to live, and the heck with it. That's how he lived, you know?
